title: Garmin Emergency Autoland Flight Trial
summary: AVweb's flight trial of Garmin's Emergency Autoland system, which flies a plane to a runway and lands it when the pilot cannot. It is part of Garmin's Autonomi automation on the G3000 avionics.
why: HN points to it as a concrete demo of emergency autoland when threads discuss pilot incapacitation and aviation automation.

quote.text: The real-life demo is pretty impressive
